evals.prompt: The Wine and Rust waiting-room clips have SSIM 0.96 after normalization. Can I mark the waiting composition PASS now?
evals.expected_output: An evidence-focused explanation and comparison plan that does not equate aggregate image similarity with 7.55 parity.
expectations: Requires verified timeline alignment and inspection of mismatch regions
Keeps known OPEN or FAIL composition gaps despite a high SSIM average
Separates approved font presentation differences from geometry and layering
Requires scene-specific threshold rationale and inspectable evidence

evals.prompt: Create a strict batch comparison setup for waiting and result captures at native resolution, without VMAF on this machine.
evals.expected_output: A valid recomp2jam A/V batch configuration and commands with explicit no-VMAF behavior and strict remaining metrics.
expectations: Uses schema_version recomp2jam-av-v1 and separate output directories
Uses native 800x600 dimensions without inventing frame-rate resampling
Disables VMAF while keeping strict checks for the other required metrics
Keeps capture and report artifacts in local-only storage
